[RSS 2024]: Expressive Whole-Body Control for Humanoid Robots

Expressive Whole-Body Control for Humanoid Robots Xuxin Cheng* · Yandong Ji* · Junming Chen Ge Yang · Xiaolong Wang Website | arXiv | Video | Summary ## Installation ## Next install fbx. Follow the instructions [here](https://github.com/nv-tlabs/ASE/issues/61). ## Prepare dataset 1. Download from [here](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1m3JRBox51cjV4CbiKIcVXR6eKQBjaAhO/view?usp=sharing) and extract the zip file to `ASE/ase/poselib/data/cmu_fbx_all` that contains all `.fbx` files. 2. Gnerate `.yaml` file for the motions you want to use. This step is not mandatory because the `.yaml` file is already generated. But if you want to add more motions, you can use this script to generate the `.yaml` file. 3. Import motions This will import all motions in CMU Mocap dataset into `ASE/ase/poselib/data/npy`. 4. Retarget motions This will retarget all motions in `ASE/ase/poselib/data/npy` to `ASE/ase/poselib/data/retarget_npy`. 5. Gnerate keybody positions This step will require running simulation to extract more precise key body positions. Train for 1 iteration and kill the program to have a dummy model to load. It is recommended to use `motions_autogen_all.yaml` at the first time, so that later if you have a subset it is not neccessary to regenerate keybody positions. This will generate keybody positions to `ASE/ase/poselib/data/retarget_npy`. Set wandb asset: ## Usage To train a new policy `xxx-xx` is usually an id like `000-01`. `motion_type` and `motion_name` are defined in `legged_gym/legged_gym/envs/h1/h1_mimic_config.py`. They can be also given as arguments. Can set default WANDB_ENTITY in `legged_gym/legged_gym/utils/helpers.py`. To play a policy No need to write the full experimentt id. The parser will auto match runs with first 6 strings (xxx-xx). So better make sure you don't reuse xxx-xx. Delay is added after 8k iters. If you want to play after 8k, add `--delay`. >[!abstract] 一句话总结：提出一种基于强化学习的全身控制框架，使用 CMU MoCap 动作捕捉数据，通过 FBX 格式导入、动作重定向和关键体位提取，训练Unitree H1 等仿真人形机器人完成多样全身动作。


# 一、动机

> 现有的人形机器人全身控制方法难以表现丰富、动态的人类动作，缺乏对全身协调和表达能力的建模。


# 二、方法

> 提出一种基于强化学习的全身控制框架，使用 CMU MoCap 动作捕捉数据，通过 FBX 格式导入、动作重定向和关键体位提取，训练Unitree H1 等仿真人形机器人完成多样全身动作。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 本文开源完整训练与评估流程，并发布预训练策略模型；摘要中未给出具体定量指标，但可演示多种动作（如不同运动类型切换）。


# 四、对我的启发

> 该方法支持更换动作子集和增量训练，可作为人形机器人全身运动控制任务的基础框架；与课题（具身智能/全身控制）直接相关。
